title: Exquisite Corpses: Fox Mask Killer #2
desc: Welcome to the Blackburn Plantation, South Carolina’s oldest seat of power. Fox Mask Killer accepted the invitation to visit, but only because it’s her last chance of keeping her daughter alive. What do the twin sisters who run this gothic estate want with the world’s deadliest retired assassin—and will she be able to stay retired for long? Ruthless rising stars CHE GRAYSON (Absolute Catwoman) and ADAM GORHAM (Infernal Hulk) continue the origin of EXQUISITE CORPSES’ breakout star here!
